rankingFactors.contextualRelevance: Images must be embedded immediately adjacent to relevant descriptive H2/H3 headings and body text.
rankingFactors.altTextPrecision: Alt attributes must contain specific target keywords describing visual subject without generic stuffing.
rankingFactors.imageObjectMicrodata: All content images must render schema.org ImageObject JSON-LD or microdata attributes.
rankingFactors.lcpOptimization: Above-the-fold hero images must load eagerly with fetchpriority='high' to maximize visual speed.
rankingFactors.cleanMetadata: Image filenames must follow dash-separated keyword naming conventions (e.g. world-cup-2026--replays--usa.webp).
rankingFactors.imageSitemapInclusion: 100% of canonical route images must be declared in app/sitemap.ts image fields.

visualSearchPlatforms: Open Graph & Twitter Large Image Cards
